interface.name: zwlr_layer_shell_v1

description.summary: create surfaces that are layers of the desktop

interface.description: Clients can use this interface to assign the surface_extension role to wl_surfaces. Such surfaces are assigned to a "layer" of the output and rendered with a defined z-order relative to normal surfaces.

request.name: get_layer_surface

description.summary: create a layer_surface from a surface

request.description:
Create a layer surface for an existing surface. This assigns the role of layer_surface, or raises a protocol error if another role is already assigned.
The layer surface is assigned to the given wl_output (or the currently focused output if output is null).

arg.name: layer
arg.summary: layer to add this surface to

request.name: destroy
request.description: This request indicates that the client will not use the layer_shell object any more. Objects that have been created through the protocol scope, however, are unaffected.

description.summary: available layers, ordered bottom to top

interface.name: zwlr_layer_surface_v1
interface.description:
An interface that may be implemented by a wl_surface, for surfaces that are designed to be rendered as a layer of a stacked desktop-like environment.
Layer surface state (layer, size, anchor, etc) is double-buffered, and will be applied at the time wl_surface.commit of the corresponding wl_surface is called.

request.name: set_size

description.summary: sets the size of the surface

request.description: Sets the size of the surface in surface-local coordinates. The compositor will display the surface centered with respect to its anchors.

request.name: set_anchor

description.summary: configures the anchor point of the surface

request.description: Requests that the compositor anchor the surface to the specified edges and corners.

request.name: set_exclusive_zone

description.summary: configures the exclusive barrier of the surface

request.description: Requests that the compositor avoids occluding an area with other surfaces.

request.name: set_margin

description.summary: sets a margin from the anchor point

request.description: Requests that the surface be placed some distance away the anchor point on the specified edges.

request.name: set_keyboard_interactivity
request.description: Set to 1 to request that the seat send keyboard events to this layer surface.

request.name: get_popup

description.summary: assign this layer_surface as an xdg_popup parent

request.description: This assigns an xdg_popup's parent to this layer_surface.

request.name: ack_configure
request.description: When a configure event is received, if a client commits the surface in response to the configure event, then the client must also acknowledge the configure by sending ack_configure.

arg.name: serial
arg.summary: the serial from the configure event

request.name: destroy
request.description: This request destroys the layer surface.

event.name: configure
event.description: The configure event asks the client to resize its surface.

event.name: closed
event.description: The closed event indicates that the layer surface is no longer valid.

description.summary: change the layer of the surface
